name: BabyAI
description: A suite of instruction-following grid-world tasks and environments for studying language-conditioned reinforcement learning and grounded language learning. BabyAI is an environment/task suite rather than a standalone static dataset; trajectories may be generated by interacting with its environments.
citation: Chevalier-Boisvert, M., Bahdanau, D., Lahlou, S., Willems, L., and others (2019). BabyAI: A Platform to Study the Sample Efficiency of Grounded Language Learning. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR). https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.08272

license.notes: The upstream BabyAI code repository specifies the MIT license, a standard SPDX identifier (MIT). This covers the repository software; environment-generated trajectories are not a bundled dataset and may have distinct applicable terms. Conceptual 12M (the BabyAI-generated pretraining corpus) is associated with the BabyAI project but is not included here; verify its provenance, terms, and any underlying-content rights before use or redistribution, as the MIT software license may not cover generated or separately distributed corpus data.
